parameters: Do you believe these people are common thugs?
What I believe doesn't matter. We're just soldiers right now.
Come on, I know you better than that. What exactly do you think the rebels want?
They don't know what they want. They're angry and confused. Lashing out against order, hoping chaos will improve their situation.\! All they understand is force, so force they shall receive.
What do you think they want, then?
They just want to be heard and understood. The Empire's taxing people to death to pay for the Succession War debts.\! If we destroy Antares, others like him will continue to speak out and rebel.

You know just as I do - an army of lambs can become lions at a moment's notice. Let's not pretend that compassion will ever result in a lasting peace.\! If the roles were reversed, if you were the one begging for mercy, do you think you would get it?
And so, we follow orders, as it is our duty. Makes everything so simple.
There's a crimson star out tonight. Haven't seen one in a long time...
It is quite a sight to behold...

Every time we have seen the crimson star, something big happens. Really big. Changes the course of history.\! Think that star is speaking to us, \n[8]? Calling upon us to do as Donar would and fix this world?
Yeah... sure. That's probably what it is.
Heh... \| Thank you for humoring me, \n[8].
